description: Check HTML/CSS against brand rules — catches off-brand colors, wrong fonts, missing logo, and anti-pattern violations (drop shadows, gradients, etc.). Pass an HTML string or file path. Mode 'check' (default) runs static source checks. Add render=true to render the page in sandboxed headless Chrome (all network blocked) and verify the COMPUTED result: actual colors vs palette (CIEDE2000), the font face that really renders, WCAG AA text contrast, logo presence, optional screenshot to .brand/checks/. Use after building any page or component, or when the user asks 'does this look on-brand?', 'check my page', or 'verify the design'. Mode 'rules' lists active rules. Returns overall PASS/WARN/FAIL, a score, and per-finding details (locator, measured value, nearest brand value, severity). NOT for scoring content copy — use brand_audit_content. NOT for brand directory validation — use brand_audit.

html.description: HTML to validate: either a full HTML string (with <style> blocks) or a file path ending in .html (e.g. 'output.html')

max_findings.description: With render=true: maximum findings returned, most severe first (default 12, max 50)

mode.description: 'check' (default): validates HTML against all brand rules. 'rules': lists all active rules without running checks.

render.description: true: render the HTML in sandboxed headless Chrome with ALL network blocked and check the computed result — actual colors vs the palette (CIEDE2000), the font face that really renders, WCAG AA text contrast, logo presence. Local CSS/JS/fonts/images inside the working directory are inlined first. Requires Chrome/Chromium. Default false (static source checks).

screenshot.description: With render=true: save a PNG of the rendered page under .brand/checks/ and return its path so you can show the user

name: brand_preflight
title: Preflight brand check
